bio:
Dream Guardian KokoLuna reporting for duty!
At night, I help to protect the dreams of people so that they may sleep peacefully. And during the day, I like to relax and chill with my moonbeams~

My channel is focused on cozy gaming streams and ASMR. I hope you enjoy and I'll see you soon in your dreams!
Business email: kokolunaVT@outlook.com
